param.description:
Param used to extract the {@link BulkSensorAssociationUiSettings}, on REL this param is populated in such a way
that it looks for {@link ReliabilityApplicationState#latestCorrelationConfig} to be defined.

Example:
```
"type": "LatestCorrelationConfigurationSwitchRenderer",
"param": {
  "type": "UiSdlApplicationStateValueParam",
  "id": "Reliability.ReliabilityApplicationState",
  "path": "latestCorrelationConfig"
}
```

title:
Determines whether to show a {@link UiSdlEmptyState} or the "Latest Correlation Configuration" Page.

- If {@link ReliabilityApplicationState#latestCorrelationConfig} is set, then `correlation` value is returned.
- Otherwise, `emptyState` string is returned.

These values (`correlation`, `emptyState`) are used by #useSwitchCondition to switch between SDL components.
name: LatestCorrelationConfigurationSwitchRenderer
